title: Migrate Chatticus marketing site (chattic.us): standard header/footer and Markus prose

comments.author: home
comments.text: Migration built on branch feature/PPY-ef96e1-papyrus-standard-front-end in Chattic.us-web (commit 068c180, local): whole public site is a standard Papyrus static site (web/projection.json, site-theme.css, 150-line hooks.py; Markus pages with page blocks; WorkspaceDemo/mark/forms/confirm+invite as islands; social previews built; offers and worked examples single-sourced). Decision: forms stay app code as islands because core forms cannot express the intake payloads (contact_type + nested details, two-phase abandoned-lead survey with dynamic questions, token pages); everything else migrated. Parity vs live (82 URLs): all present, text identical on 57, 12 within 3% (chatticus docs drift since last deploy), explained diffs on 13; head metadata diffs allow-listed. Blocked on: core page-blocks release (PR #424 open, python check failing); PyPI 5.2.0/5.3.0 do not contain it.
